text_block_list.text: While consulting with Narita Brian about today's training menu—

text_block_list.name: Novelist
text_block_list.text:
I knew it...
You are truly the ideal model for my novel!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Who the heck are you?

text_block_list.name: Novelist
text_block_list.text:
I am a novelist. I received permission today
to search for inspiration for my story!
choice_data_list: You're giving that model to Brian?

text_block_list.name: Novelist
text_block_list.text: Yes! It's a story where the overwhelmingly strongest Umamusume reincarnates into a fantasy world—

text_block_list.name: Reincarnated Brian
text_block_list.text: Reincarnated or not, I'm still an Umamusume. Did you really think you could outrun these legs?

text_block_list.name: Reincarnated Brian
text_block_list.text:
Now, draw your sword—resist, and challenge me.
All for my entertainment.

text_block_list.name: Novelist
text_block_list.text:
See?! Brian-san fits the picture
of a main protagonist so perfectly!

text_block_list.name: Novelist
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of this masterpiece,
please, let me hear your story!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I have nothing to say to you.
You're interfering with my training.

text_block_list.name: Novelist
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh! ...Trainer-san!
Please, at least let me just watch the training!
choice_data_list: Then I'll just watch from off to the side.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hmph... Let's get moving already.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Phew... That's 3 sets of 50 done.

text_block_list.name: Novelist
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, mhm, weight is about this much...
Then equipping a greatsword or an axe might be best~

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Warm-up's over.
We're doubling the weights.

text_block_list.name: Novelist
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what!? Double!?
...Th-That's completely off the charts... isn't it...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...
Finished five laps around the course.

text_block_list.name: Novelist
text_block_list.text:
The distance I can run is 5 laps of the course, huh...
This is as expected! I'll use it as reference for my work—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Next, take off your ankle weights and run 3 laps.

text_block_list.name: Novelist
text_block_list.text: Eeeh!? Weights on my ankles!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Novelist
text_block_list.text:
Amazing...
So this is "Narita Brian"...

text_block_list.name: Novelist
text_block_list.text:
Less of a reference and more of... a shock... I have
created various protagonists up until now, but—

text_block_list.name: Novelist
text_block_list.text:
Today, everything else paled in comparison.
Her sheer spirit far surpassed any dramatic fiction...!

text_block_list.name: Novelist
text_block_list.text:
"I want to write about her!
A novel with Brian-san as the protagonist!!"
choice_data_list: Huh!? What about the fantasy novel!?

text_block_list.name: Novelist
text_block_list.text:
I... I just can't get the sight of what I witnessed
right before my eyes out of my head!

text_block_list.name: Novelist
text_block_list.text:
Brian-san! Please tell me more about you,
and about your strength!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Tch... I refuse. It'll get in the way of my running.

text_block_list.name: Novelist
text_block_list.text:
No way... A-At least, Trainer!
Please tell me! What was the true nature of that fighting spirit...?!

text_block_list.name: Novelist
text_block_list.text: I see! The sheer power in your stride when you ran was incredible, too!

text_block_list.name: Novelist
text_block_list.text:
The image is really coming together! "With arms that
can lift giant trees, and legs that can shatter the earthâ!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I can't deal with this.
I'm continuing my training.

text_block_list.name: Novelist
text_block_list.text:
Oh! "Sprinting away like an eagle
hunting its prey"...!
The novelist had been thrilled, but... days later, word arrived that he had given up on writing the piece, feeling unable to truly capture that sheer power.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Novelist
text_block_list.text:
I see... All right, I'm going to stick right with you!
A masterpiece is only born from persistent reporting!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Tch... Annoying.
I'm going on my run around the academy as planned.

text_block_list.name: Novelist
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Please wait! If it's come to this,
I'll chase after them in a car and find where they're resting—

text_block_list.name: Novelist
text_block_list.text:
W-When is she gonna stop!?
Could this stamina be the secret behind that fighting spirit!?

Narita Brian scolded me afterward,
but running away turned out to be great practice.
